Maya Singh: Candidate Theo Martin (Design Ops) is flying in from Toronto (EDT). Interview day Tue Oct 12. He asked if we cover a one-way rideshare from the train station (~$45 CAD) and needs a printed badge + short-term parking. Can someone take logistics?
Connor Blake: I can take this. Need Theo's email and full name as on ID. Also confirm if he needs a laptop loaner.
Maya Singh: Theo's email: theo.martin.candidate@example.com, passport name Theo James Martin, phone +1 416 555 0147. He said no laptop needed. Dietary: pescatarian. He asked about timeline for reimbursement.
people-ops-bot: Reimbursement note: local transit or rideshare under $75 CAD, submit receipt to expenses@redwood.com within 30 days with tag "interview-travel". For pre-approved vendor credits submit to people-ops@redwood.com 48h before travel. Link: https://intranet.redwood/people-ops/reimbursements (internal).
Samir Kaur: I'll prereg the printed badge and request short-term parking hold at reception (pickup between 13:30-14:00). Parking note: curbside drop ok, long-term requires approval. I'll email Theo the pickup details once badge is ready.
Connor Blake: I'll offer a rideshare credit since it's under $75 CAD. Theo please reply confirming pickup address and we'll send a vendor credit. Also adding pescatarian lunch note to invites.
Maya Singh: Theo confirmed pickup address and will keep receipt. He appreciated the quick answer.
people-ops-bot: Candidate record updated: "Theo Martin - Toronto; printed badge prereg; short-term parking hold; rideshare credit issued pending receipt; dietary: pescatarian."
Samir Kaur: Action items: Samir confirm badge at reception by EOD Fri; Connor to send rideshare credit; Maya to include dietary note in calendar invite.
Connor Blake: Credit sent to Theo via vendor portal. Closing loop.
